# Test fixtures

Everything here was made for infonium's tests. No page, document or recording of a third party is among it.

- `pdf/samples`: 16 PDFs drawn for infonium (7.1 MB). Between them they hold text layers and scans, a made-up article and magazine page, tables, code and marks, a dozen writing systems, vertical Japanese, pages stored turned, a file with a text layer on some pages only, and the cases earlier reviews found.
- `pdf/engine`: what MinerU 3.4.2 wrote for each sample when called as infonium calls it (52 KB, gzipped). It holds the results the reader reads, `*_middle.json`, and for a file read as pictures the lines it detected, `*_model.json`. The engine's pictures of the pages are left out.
- `pdf/readings`: the title and blocks that commit 6facef0 read from each sample (229 KB). A fresh run of the engine gave the same on 2026-11-21. Since then a picture or chart the engine finds is a figure block of its own, without words or places, and the readings hold those figures where they stand, and the picture drawn for each, by its block and its size in pixels; every other block is as 6facef0 read it.
- `page/forged_mark_on_a_block.html`: a page Hypothesis made from the strategy of `tests/test_page.py`, kept as the example on which a span that the page itself marked with block 0 holds, as the extractor reads it, exactly the text of a block of its own.
- `pdf/handed.json`: the engine's options, and for each sample the SHA-256 of the file the reference handed the engine, without the identifier in its trailer.
- `library_before_digest_styles`: a library that the service of commit bdd3e97 kept (244 KB), made by `tests/library_before_digest_styles.py`: two made-up pages read, a digest of one, a highlight of each, a note and a translation, and in `answers.json` what the service answered about them. The tests of digest styles open a copy of it, to check that a library kept before digests had styles opens with all it held.
- `library_before_folders`: the file of a library that the service of commit 3ddbaaa kept (252 KB), the last before folders, made by `tests/library_before_folders.py`, without its snapshots: for one owner, subscriptions reading and paused, the item of a subscription removed, a page, a PDF (`pdf/samples/trap.pdf`), an address whose reading failed and a made-up recording; for another, a subscription and a page; and in `answers.json` what the service answered each owner of their items and subscriptions. The tests of folders open a copy of it, to check that a library kept before folders answers as it did, with everything in no folder.

Eight samples of the set the reference was made from are left out to keep the data small: the 40-page scan, two searchable scans, a scan and a born-digital file with text in pictures, the drop-cap cases, a second scan of the article, and the scan of the writing systems.
